We're Bramwell Logistics Software, a Manchester-based team of 40 building route-planning tools for UK hauliers, and we're hiring a mid-level .NET developer to join our core platform squad.
Day to day you'll write C# on .NET 8, design schemas and queries in SQL Server, and deploy services to Azure. You should have at least three years of commercial C# experience, be comfortable with Entity Framework Core and have shipped something to Azure in production. If you've used Angular or Azure DevOps pipelines, that's a plus, but we'll teach you what you need.
We pay £55k to £68k, plus a 10% bonus, 28 days holiday plus bank holidays, a 5% pension contribution, private healthcare and a Cycle to Work scheme. You can work remote up to four days a week.
Bramwell is an equal opportunity employer. Send a CV or GitHub link to Sam Okafor at careers@bramwell-ls.example.
